claim: selected bandwidth 0.05 everywhere; support-vector kernel mean ~0.993, SD ~0.008; alignment 0.04 at 0.05 vs 0.46 at 0.25; Gaussian correlation ~0.94
bandwidth_grid_justification: inputs are min-max encoded to [0, pi]; u = bandwidth * x; exp(-i u Z) has period pi in u, so bandwidth 1 spans one full period and bandwidths above 1 wrap distinct inputs onto equal single-qubit phases; the lower end is where off-diagonal entries exceed 0.999
point_sets_note: only support vectors are stored; each set is the union of the quantum kernel's and its RBF control's support vectors (identical encoders), labels from the sign of the dual coefficients. These are real training points but biased towards the decision boundary; full training kernels cannot be built
